requirements: Reflect GET operations with exactly one supported required string path parameter.
Expose the path parameter through the existing generic arguments object.
Substitute the argument into the path using path-segment-safe percent encoding.
Send GET without an HTTP request body.
Do not send Content-Type when there is no request body.
Validate the structured JSON response using the existing generic response schema machinery.
Reject missing and unknown structured arguments before network transport.
Abstain on optional path parameters, non-string path parameters, and unsupported additional query parameters.
Add no provider-specific or Cloudflare-specific behavior.
Add no new MCP tool names.
Make no change to the generic context_run MCP arguments schema.
